name: Tm Visualization Suite: Temporal Patterns
pitch: See daily rhythm, seasons and trends in one view, and spot the days that break the pattern.
question: When do things happen, and how do the patterns repeat over time?
useWhen: Show how a value moves and repeats over time.
features: Compare many series on one rhythm
Pack a long series into a small space
Lay the years on top of each other
Watch the mix change over time

hero.alt: Calendar heatmap of daily sales over three years, one block per year, with the darkest days around December.
hero.caption: Every day of three years at once: the busy weeks stand out

screenshots.alt: Seasonal heatmap with years as rows and months as columns, coloured by sales and darkest in December.
screenshots.caption: A seasonal heatmap shows which months run high, year by year

screenshots.alt: Line chart of monthly sales for one region with one line for each year, running January to December.
screenshots.caption: Select one region and the yearly lines show its own season

questions: Which weekdays and months are busiest?
How do regions compare across the same years?
Which categories grow or fade over the seasons?
audience: Analysts and BI leads who look for rhythm, seasons and trends in sales or activity over time.

featureStrips.heading: Compare many series on one rhythm
featureStrips.text: Ridgelines stack one small trend per group, so you can compare their shape and timing at a glance.
featureStrips.alt: Ridgeline chart with one daily trend per region stacked on a shared time axis.

featureStrips.heading: Pack a long series into a small space
featureStrips.text: Horizon bands fold a long series into bands of colour, so many weeks fit in one slim strip.
featureStrips.alt: Horizon chart of weekly sales, folded into bands of orange and blue over four years.

featureStrips.heading: Lay the years on top of each other
featureStrips.text: A cycle plot draws one line per year over the same months, so you see the season and the trend.
featureStrips.alt: Line chart of monthly sales with one line for each year, all running January to December.

featureStrips.heading: Watch the mix change over time
featureStrips.text: A streamgraph stacks the groups into flowing bands, so you see which grow and which shrink.
featureStrips.alt: Streamgraph of monthly sales by product group, stacked areas that widen and narrow over time.
